title: Events bubble

blocks.promptMd: You click the inner button. `event.target` is…
A click on the inner button makes `event.target` the parent with the listener.
blocks.explainMd: target is the node that was clicked. currentTarget is the node whose listener is running.

blocks.promptMd: > On click of `#outer`, write `targetId>currentId` into `#out`. Hidden test clicks `#inner`.

hintLadder.md: Listen on `#outer`, not on the inner button alone.
Join them with `>` and write that into `#out`.

description: A click rises through the tree unless you stop it.
